weapon.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, grants Atk/Def+5 during combat, and also, if foe can make a follow-up attack, reduces damage from foe's first attack by 50%.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, grants Atk/Def+5 during combat, and also, if foe can make a follow-up attack, reduces damage from foe's first attack by 50%.

At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants 【Preempt Pulse】and【Atk Liberate】to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and restores 7 HP to unit when unit deals damage to foe during combat.
【Preempt Pulse】
Grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit before unit's first attack during combat.
【Atk Liberate】
Grants bonus to Atk during combat = number of【Bonus】effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).
【Bonus】
All effects that last "for 1 turn" or "that turn only." Includes bonuses granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and positive status effects (extra movement or effects like Dominance).

assist.d: Unit moves 1 space away from target ally. Ally moves to unit's previous space.

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd/Def+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

c.d: Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+2 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+3 during combat."
Allies within 2 spaces gain: "If foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+4 during combat."
